name: BrainCool AB
summary: BrainCool AB (publ), a medical technology company founded in 2010 and headquartered in Lund, Sweden, focuses on the development, commercialization, and distribution of advanced medical cooling systems. The company caters to the healthcare sector, primarily serving the Swedish market, by providing innovative solutions for various conditions including stroke, sudden cardiac arrest, oral mucositis, and migraine. Their product line features the BrainCool and RhinoChill systems, engineered to deliver swift therapeutic cooling in emergency situations.
